name: MAXX Body Rub I 1000mg THC : 1000mg CBD
description:
MAXX Topical Body Rub 
Dosage: 1000mg THC : 1000mg CBD 
Activation Time: 10 - 15 minutes 
75ML | 2.5 FL OZ 
Possesses an unscented natural aroma. 
Find reliable relief where it matters most. Pain may be inevitable but suffering is not! Our topical is non-transdermal, meaning it does not get you high, making it the perfect fit for all day use in any environment. 
Apply the balm directly to the affected area, gently massage until completely absorbed. Store the container in cooler temperatures and keep out of direct sunlight. 
Ingredients: Coconut Oil, Beeswax, Mango Butter, Shea Butter, THC Distillate, CBD Isolate, Grapeseed oil, Frankincense essential oil, Camphor oil, Lavender essential oil, Vitamin E oil, Rosehip oil, Mineral oil, Helichrysum essential oil, Myrrh essential oil
